alas.freq and alas.phdos: reference outputs of matdyn.x from Quantum ESPRESSO,
PHonon/examples/example02/reference (https://github.com/QEF/q-e, tag qe-7.6; the files are
identical in every release from 6.4.1 to 7.6). Quantum ESPRESSO is distributed under the
GNU General Public License, version 2 or later. Used here as samples of the older matdyn
formats: 3-number q-point lines and a phonon DOS without per-atom columns.
